verdict.rationale: Isaac ROS provides 'ready-to-use packages' for navigation/perception deployable on workstations and Jetson, and Isaac Sim can import URDF/CAD and bridge to ROS 2 for validation, which speeds up some integration steps — but there is no explicit claim or evidence about bringing up a *new physical robot's* drivers/configuration/first motion in hours vs weeks. missing for 10: concrete hardware driver bring-up workflow, time-to-first-motion case study, real-robot config walkthrough, independent user reports of fast bring-up.
